versions.content: When J1939Dcm_RequestIndication is called and any other diagnostic message (apart from DM01 and DM35 ) is currently processed, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_CANNOT_RESPOND to send a negative acknowledgement (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).

When J1939Dcm_RequestIndication is called and any other diagnostic message (apart from DM01 and DM35 ) is currently processed, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_CANNOT_RESPOND to send a negative acknowledgement (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).

When J1939Dcm_RequestIndication is called and any other diagnostic message (apart from DM01 and DM35 ) is currently processed, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call J1939Rm_SendAck with parame ters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_CANNOT_RESPOND to send a negative acknowledgement (considering [SWS_J1939Dcm_00113] ).
